This supports a bounded future ergonomics audit: shorten common local paths for features, embeddings, acquisition, and document composition while retaining existing checked domain types and keeping remote authorization/receipts explicit as advanced custody behavior. The live embeddings page now separates its short local path from the 107-line full receipt-bound program, so docs no longer manufacture simplicity while API design remains open.
